why: The bracket follows displayed power: roll for power ('순수 뻥투'), weapons and plates first; crit resist and crit dmg inflate most. Near-ties: Skill AMP, Haste or DR.

substats: Fill the stats the set lacks; don't stack accuracy/focus past the requirement
why: Balanced stats show more power: duplicates add little, missing stats a lot. An accuracy/focus-heavy set lowers power and can drop the bracket.
900 accuracy is enough to 328 post-easing; ND러너 keeps about 1,000 past 300, calls 1,300 wasted. Take accuracy pieces that also add power.

substats: Skill AMP + crit rate (accuracy or focus if short)
why: Skill AMP is the must-have weapon line, then crit; stage enemies lack crit resistance, so one guide prefers crit rate. Accuracy or focus if short.
Useless in the fight (stage mobs don't crit) but inflates displayed power; keep it only when the bracket line is what's missing.

substats: Skill AMP + Skill Haste (accuracy or focus if short)
why: About three Skill Haste lines across accessories keep heals and buffs turning; one 240-30 GingerCraven clear needed 20+ from gear.

substats: Anything with the highest power (DR + HP when survival fails)
why: Armour is taken for power. When the front line dies (GingerCraven's burst before the easing), damage reduction and HP replace crit resist and evasion.

substats: A pure-power preset for the bracket line, a Skill Haste preset for auto
why: Two presets: all Skill Haste for auto, pure power when sitting just under a bracket line. The 301-27 15% clear used one named 뻥투.
